text: Twenty videos ago, Cascade Ridge Outfitters tracked warranty claims by email and memory. Today, Warranty_Claim__c runs the whole process for about 150 people.
Along the way, a real Role Hierarchy visibility gap was found and fixed -- without touching the sharing rule, which was correct from the start.
Three honest gaps remain, named plainly: no customer self-service portal, no automated SLA escalation, and no automated Role Hierarchy audit.
None of them are failures. They're the real, scoped-out edges of a V1 build, left for a future phase instead of hidden.
This is a finished project, not a perfect one. Thank you for building it end to end.
